name: event-viewer
description: This micro-app can be used as a test subscriber and/or emitter of [CloudEvents](https://cloudevents.io/).

scripts.start: npm run copy && parcel serve src/ui/index.html src/ui/html/*.html src/ui/html/components/*.html --public-url /static/ --dist-dir static
scripts.dev: npm run copy && parcel serve src/ui/index.html src/ui/html/*.html src/ui/html/components/*.html --public-url /static/ --dist-dir static --hmr-port 1234
scripts.build: npm run copy && parcel build src/ui/index.html src/ui/html/*.html src/ui/html/components/*.html --public-url /static/ --dist-dir static --no-scope-hoist
